subject: Private VPC pricing - token volumes & licensing options for PaymentsAI
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@paymentsai.com>, Procurement <procurement@paymentsai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC pricing - token volumes & licensing options for PaymentsAI

Hi Alex / Procurement team -

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery + a couple of asks so we can put together a scoped Private/VPC quote: 

Summary from call:
- PaymentsAI is evaluating a Private (VPC) deployment for production ML inference (sensitive payments data).
- Expected baseline token volumes: you mentioned 200M - 600M tokens/month initially with spikes up to ~1B for seasonal peaks.
- Environments: prod + staging + dev (please confirm if you need additional test clusters).
- Support: looks like you want 24/7/enterprise-level support and an SLA for incident response.
- Licensing model preference: you indicated preference for a platform license + per-token usage (rather than per-seat).

A few asks to finalize pricing tiers: 
1) Can you confirm a target $/1M tokens range you're budgeting for? (ballpark is fine - e.g., $50-$200/1M tokens)
2) Confirm environment count (prod/staging/dev) and whether any environments need dedicated capacity (isolated GPUs).
3) Any procurement timelines & PO terms we should be aware of (Net30/Net45)?

I've attached a quick pricing template to capture volumes & preferred terms to speed up the quote (redwood-private-pricing-template.xlsx). Once you confirm the above I'll share a short, scoped pricing proposal and mutual action plan.

Next steps: 
- PaymentsAI to confirm target $/1M tokens & environment count (action: Alex)
- Redwood to return formal Private/VPC proposal (action: Ben) - target 2 business days after confirmation

Thanks - looking forward to nailing this down.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@paymentsai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@paymentsai.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing - token volumes & licensing options for PaymentsAI

Hi Ben -

Thanks for the follow-up and the template. A few clarifications from our side: 

Token volumes:
- Baseline: ~200M tokens/month (first 3 months)
- Expected steady-state (6-12mo): 400M - 600M tokens/month
- Peak/seasonal: up to ~1B tokens/month for a couple of weeks (we need graceful handling of spikes)

Budget & unit economics: 
- We're targeting roughly $15k - $40k / month for inference spend initially; we expect this to grow.
- If it helps, our internal target is to keep effective spend at or under $80 - $120 per 1M tokens (this is a target; open to vendor structure that hits our TCO).

Licensing & environments: 
- Preferred model: platform license (annual) + per-token usage (OPEX).
- Environments: 3 (prod, staging, dev). Prod needs to be isolated (dedicated capacity), staging can be shared, dev is low-priority.

Support & procurement: 
- We need Enterprise support (24/7, phone escalation) and SOC2 evidence for procurement.
- Procurement is on a Net30 cadence; I've attached our RFP/requirements document (PaymentsAI_RFP_Q3.docx).

Next steps from us: I'll confirm final internal budget band by Monday (20-Sep). Procurement would like a draft SOW + pricing to review.

Thanks - Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering | PaymentsAI
alex.j@paymentsai.com

On Wed, Sep 15, 2027 at 3:23 PM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference> wrote:

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Procurement <procurement@paymentsai.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing - token volumes & licensing options for PaymentsAI

Alex -

Appreciate the clear numbers. Based on the volumes & preference for a platform license + per-token OPEX, here's a high-level ballpark to align on structure before we generate a formal SOW: 

Private / VPC pricing (ballpark):
- Annual platform license (Private/VPC) for 3 environments with dedicated prod capacity: $100,000 - $140,000 / year (one-time annual fee)
- Per-token OPEX tiers (monthly billing, price per 1M tokens):
  - 0-100M: $180 / 1M tokens
  - 100M-500M: $120 / 1M tokens
  - 500M+: custom volume tier (we can push into $70 - $90 / 1M at committed volumes)
- Enterprise support (24/7 + named SLAs): additional $30,000 / year (or bundled as part of a committed package)

Using your steady-state example (say 500M tokens/month): at $120 / 1M => ~ $60,000 / month in token spend + platform/license amortized (~$10k/month) => total ~ $70k/month. If you commit to higher annual volume or multi-year, we can get to your target effective $/1M range.

We'll include SOC2 summary and supporting docs in the formal proposal. I've attached a draft pricing proposal (Private-VPC-pricing-proposal-v1.pdf) with a simple MA plan and opt-in cost optimizations (caching, quantization advisory, reserved batching) to reduce billable tokens.

Next steps I propose: 
- Ben to deliver formal SOW + line-item quote by EOD Tue (21-Sep) after we get final budget confirmation from you (Alex).
- PaymentsAI to confirm any procurement contract language around data residency & encryption (action: Procurement).

If the $70k/month estimate at 500M looks out of range for you, call me and we'll discuss commitment discounts and engineering mitigations to lower unit costs.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference

Attachments: Private-VPC-pricing-proposal-v1.pdf (pdf)

2) Pricing ask / proposal draft:
- Platform license: propose $120k / year (3 envs)
- Token tiers: 0-100M $180/1M; 100-500M $120/1M; 500M+ negotiate to $70-90/1M with commit
- Enterprise support: $30k / year (opt-in)

3) Commercial next steps (Marissa):
- Build a formal SOW & line-item quote; include a 12-month commit and a 60-day trial for staging if required.
- Add SOC2 summary attachment and standard data-residency clause.

Timing: PaymentsAI will confirm budget by EOD Mon (20-Sep). They want a draft SOW for procurement review. Can we have a quote ready by EOD Tue (21-Sep)?
